title: Johnny Cash Inspired 2-Suite Loft In 12 South
description:
Bring the whole crew to the heart of 12 South. The dramatic penthouse loft, is inspired by Jonny Cash, with a private king suite and an upstairs suite with two queen beds. Gather beneath soaring ceilings, play a few songs on the piano, relax in CoWrite’s shared courtyard, or head downstairs for tacos and coffee. Belmont and 12 South favorites are within walking distance, with downtown just a quick ride away.

The space
Welcome to The Bradford, located in 12th South and less than 3 miles to everything Broadway has to offer! Soaring ceilings, dramatic finishes, and a location that can't be beat make this loft-style apartment the ultimate destination for an upscale Nashville escape. Professionally designed with thoughtful touches at every turn, you and your guests will be able to unwind in privacy, without ever being far from the action. This listing is for a 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment in a 7-unit building located in the heart of 12th South.

Upon entering this penthouse, guests will be immediately struck by the moody, dramatic vibe that extends throughout this Johnny Cash inspired home. Every part of this home has been thoughtfully renovated to create a uniquely Nashville experience for our guests. 

Comfortable Accommodation:  
- 1st Floor Suite: 1 king bed with a full bathroom  
- 2nd Floor Suite: 2 queen beds with a full bathroom  

Interior Feeling:  
- Open floor plan connecting the living room and kitchen  
- Soaring ceilings create an urban loft feel  
- Brand new velvet couches for relaxation  
- Working piano for musical inspiration  
- Fully outfitted kitchen with new brick wall accents  
- Blackout curtains in bedrooms for restful sleep  
- Smart TVs in both bedrooms  

Outdoor Bliss:  
- Shared courtyard available for guest use  
- Shared propane grill for outdoor cooking  
- Furniture in the courtyard for lounging  
- Unwind under the stars or enjoy morning coffee in the courtyard 

Delightful Dining:  
- Located within walking distance of some of Nashville's finest restaurants  
- Close to LadyBird Taco (1 minute), Hattie B's Hot Chicken (12 minute walk), and Draper James (10 minute walk)  

Professional Cleaning:  
- Laundry room with stacked washer/dryer  
- Laundry pods stocked for your convenience  

Parking:  
Complimentary parking in the shared rear lot is first come, first served, with free street parking nearby.

Long Term Living:  
Looking for a comfortable, furnished home in Nashville for an extended stay? We've got you covered. If you're interested, feel free to reach out to learn more! Please take note that there is a refundable security deposit of $500 charged separately before check-in for any reservations between 22 days and 6 months, and a deposit of $1,000 charged separately before check-in for any reservations over 6 months.  

These units are on the second story of this building, and each one is two stories, so stairs are a must here. Permit: CASR 2016_followed by_071328.

Guest access
You'll have access to a first come first served parking lot as well as the common area. We encourage you to visit LadyBird Taco or E+Rose  in the building!

Other things to note
Welcome to our boutique hospitality experience, led by a close-knit team of husband-and-wife duo and their close friends. We've been making dream vacations come true since 2014 and we're thrilled to do the same for you! We choose our properties with care, only offering places we'd love to stay in ourselves. You'll find top local spots around each location and we're always ready to suggest the best picks tailored just for you.

- Check-In: We provide a unique, custom door code for each stay for secure and easy keyless entry.
- Guest Verification: All guests are required to complete an additional guest verification process after booking, which includes signing a liability agreement.
- Local Bookings: We typically do not host local residents. We may inquire about the purpose of your stay and reserve the right to decline bookings.
- Security Deposit: A refundable security deposit is required for longer stays and is charged separately before check-in. The deposit is $500 for reservations between 22 days and 6 months, and $1,000 for reservations over 6 months.
- Child-Friendly Rentals: If you need a pack and play or high chair, please inquire for a unique link to rent these items.
- 24/7 Support: Our team is available around the clock to help with any questions or personalized requests.
- Permit Numbers: CASR 2016_followed by_071328
